description: This Java class is a command handler for updating teller entities within the Apache Fineract platform. It processes update commands and forwards them to the TellerWritePlatformService.

classes.name: UpdateTellerCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring Service class that handles update commands for tellers by delegating to the TellerWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes an update command for a teller and delegates the modification to the service layer.
